name: @aiti-ai/aiti-containers
description: Container explorer for the pi-web AI window: containers / images / volumes / networks / compose projects with whitelisted actions, plus agent tools over docker, podman and nerdctl.

descriptionI18n.zh-CN: AI 窗里的容器浏览器：容器 / 镜像 / 卷 / 网络 / compose 项目，操作走白名单，另带 docker / podman / nerdctl 的 agent 工具

soul: 容器不是黑盒——看得见、点得动，AI 也说得清。

soulI18n.en: Containers are not a black box — you can see them, click them, and the AI can explain them.
